name: coaching-fee-management
description: Coaching institute fee management system with parent portal (MERN + TypeScript)

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.dev:memory: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm --prefix server run dev:memory" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix client run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix server run typecheck && npm --prefix client exec tsc -b
